description: This file defines the class 'GenericBasicDisplayField' within the 'OrangeHRM' project, specifically in the 'Core\Report\DisplayField' namespace. The class extends 'BasicDisplayField' and provides a mapping from various employee data fields to database entity aliases and fields, along with methods to set and retrieve this mapping based on display field objects.

classes.name: GenericBasicDisplayField
classes.description: A class that maps display field aliases to entity and field names in the context of reporting, extending 'BasicDisplayField' and providing methods to set and access entity information based on display field objects.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the entity alias and field based on the provided DisplayField object by using a predefined mapping.
